Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for a driver's license renewal exemption for active foreign service members.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a driver's license renewal exemption for activeforeign service members; and amending RCW 46.20.027.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.20.027 and 2002 c 292 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A Washington state motor vehicle driver's license issued to anyservice member if valid and in force and effect while such person isserving in the armed forces or the foreign service, shall remain infull force and effect so long as such service continues unless the sameis sooner suspended, canceled, or revoked for cause as provided by lawand for not to exceed ninety days following the date on which theholder of such driver's license is honorably separated from service inthe armed forces or the foreign service of the United States. AWashington state driver's license issued to the spouse or dependentchild of such service member likewise remains in full force and effectif the person is residing with the service member. For purposes of this section, "service member" means every personserving in (1) the armed forces whose branch of service as of the dateof application for the driver's license is included in the definition p. 1 HB 2924of veteran pursuant to RCW 41.04.007 or the person will meet thedefinition of veteran at the time of discharge, or (2) the foreignservice.
